name: Karin（カリン）
description: Karin 原生形态键（blink_L、jitome_L、kuchi_smile_1_L、mayu_angry_1_L、LookUp 等）。vrc.blink_left 等是空键，不使用。标了 guessed 的需要游戏实测。
description_en: Karin's native shape keys (blink_L, jitome_L, kuchi_smile_1_L, mayu_angry_1_L, LookUp, ...). vrc.blink_left and the like are empty keys and are not used. Mappings marked guessed need testing in game.

channels.name: mayu_up_L
channels.note: 眉毛上移（左侧）。最大位移 10.1mm（karin）。整条眉毛上移。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (left). Max displacement 10.1 mm (karin). Whole brow up. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mayu_up_R
channels.note: 眉毛上移（右侧）。最大位移 10.1mm（karin）。整条眉毛上移。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (right). Max displacement 10.1 mm (karin). Whole brow up. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mayu_down_L
channels.note: 眉毛下压（左侧）。最大位移 11.8mm（karin）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (left). Max displacement 11.8 mm (karin). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mayu_down_R
channels.note: 眉毛下压（右侧）。最大位移 11.8mm（karin）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (right). Max displacement 11.8 mm (karin). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mayu_sad_1_L
channels.note: 眉头上提（左侧）。最大位移 8.6mm（karin）。mayu_sad_1：眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (left). Max displacement 8.6 mm (karin). mayu_sad_1: inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: mayu_sad_1_R
channels.note: 眉头上提（右侧）。最大位移 8.6mm（karin）。mayu_sad_1：眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (right). Max displacement 8.6 mm (karin). mayu_sad_1: inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: mayu_angry_1_L
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（左侧）。最大位移 13.9mm（karin）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (left). Max displacement 13.9 mm (karin). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mayu_angry_1_R
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（右侧）。最大位移 13.9mm（karin）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (right). Max displacement 13.9 mm (karin). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: blink_L
channels.note: 闭眼（左侧）。最大位移 30.1mm（karin）
channels.note_en: Eye closed (left). Max displacement 30.1 mm (karin)

channels.name: blink_R
channels.note: 闭眼（右侧）。最大位移 30.1mm（karin）
channels.note_en: Eye closed (right). Max displacement 30.1 mm (karin)

channels.name: jitome_L
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（左侧）。最大位移 7.3mm（karin）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (left). Max displacement 7.3 mm (karin)

channels.name: jitome_R
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（右侧）。最大位移 7.3mm（karin）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (right). Max displacement 7.3 mm (karin)

channels.name: surprise_L
channels.note: 睁大眼（左侧）。最大位移 2.2mm（karin）
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (left). Max displacement 2.2 mm (karin)

channels.name: surprise_R
channels.note: 睁大眼（右侧）。最大位移 2.2mm（karin）
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (right). Max displacement 2.2 mm (karin)

channels.name: LowerEyelid_up_L
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（左侧）。最大位移 5.5mm（karin）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (left). Max displacement 5.5 mm (karin). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: LowerEyelid_up_R
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（右侧）。最大位移 5.5mm（karin）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (right). Max displacement 5.5 mm (karin). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: kuchi_A
channels.note: 张嘴。最大位移 10.5mm（karin）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 jawDrop，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth open. Max displacement 10.5 mm (karin). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal jawDrop, the larger wins

channels.name: kuchi_U
channels.note: u 口型（嘴唇收拢）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 7.2mm（karin）
channels.note_en: "u" mouth shape (lips rounded); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 7.2 mm (karin)

channels.name: kuchi_smile_1_L
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（左侧）。最大位移 1.8mm（karin）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (left). Max displacement 1.8 mm (karin). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.L, the larger wins

channels.name: kuchi_smile_1_R
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（右侧）。最大位移 1.8mm（karin）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.R，取较大者

channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (left). Max displacement 1.8 mm (karin). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: kuchi_angry_1_R
channels.note: 嘴角下垂（右侧）。最大位移 1.8mm（karin）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (right). Max displacement 1.8 mm (karin). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: kuchi_wide
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 4.1mm（karin）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.L / mouthCornerOut.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 4.1 mm (karin). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.L / mouthCornerOut.R, the larger wins

channels.name: kuchi_narrow
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 3.1mm（karin）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 3.1 mm (karin)

channels.name: kuchi_up
channels.note: 嘴整体上移。最大位移 4.3mm（karin）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth up. Max displacement 4.3 mm (karin)

channels.name: kuchi_down
channels.note: 嘴整体下移。最大位移 3.9mm（karin）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth down. Max displacement 3.9 mm (karin)

channels.name: LookUp
channels.note: 虹膜上移。最大位移 4.1mm（karin）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris up. Max displacement 4.1 mm (karin). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: LookDown
channels.note: 虹膜下移。最大位移 4.4mm（karin）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris down. Max displacement 4.4 mm (karin). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: LookLeft
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色左侧。最大位移 4.1mm（karin）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's left. Max displacement 4.1 mm (karin). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: LookRight
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色右侧。最大位移 4.1mm（karin）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's right. Max displacement 4.1 mm (karin). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.
